tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Returns Global FinReg's LEI prices in every supported currency, excluding VAT: for a new registration and for a renewal, for 1, 3 and 5 years, each as pricePerYear and total for the whole period; and the optional fully assisted service. For the exact total for one LEI, including VAT, use get_registr

tools.name: create_user
tools.description: Creates a Global FinReg account for a user from their email address, so they can order and manage LEIs. GFR emails the address a link to set a password; you get no access to the account from this tool. After the user has set a password, register for access with /auth.md and use the account tools. If

tools.name: search_lei_by_company_name
tools.description: Searches the global LEI register by legal entity name. Returns matching entities with their LEI, country and a link to the entity's GlobalFinReg lookup page.

tools.name: get_lei_record
tools.description: Returns the registration record of an LEI from the global LEI register: legal name, legal and headquarters address, jurisdiction, legal form, entity and registration status, registration and renewal dates and the managing LOU.

tools.name: lookup_legal_form
tools.description: Looks up an entity legal form (ISO 20275 ELF code list) in a country: by ELF code first, otherwise by the legal form's local name, optionally within a region of the country.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_user" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_user" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_user · Private data: create_user, get_lei_record · Public sink: create_user.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_user · Private data: create_user, get_lei_record · Public sink: create_user

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
